title: Block numerical ranges for linear relations
summary: Linear relations are multivalued generalizations of linear operators whose spectral properties are closely linked to the stability of differential-algebraic equations. Consequently, reliable spectral enclosures are of considerable interest. In this note, we extend the established concept of the block numerical range from operators to linear relations by means of a range representation. Unlike the classical numerical range, the resulting block numerical range may be nonconvex and can therefore detect gaps in the spectrum.
